1→/**
     2→ * Tokenizer module for converting various input types to standardized string tokens.
     3→ *
     4→ * This module demonstrates Scala's expressive type system with:
     5→ * - Sealed traits and case classes for algebraic data types
     6→ * - Variance annotations (covariant/contravariant)
     7→ * - Pattern matching for type-safe dispatch
     8→ * - Option/Either for safe absence and error handling
     9→ * - Traits as structural typing replacements for Python Protocols
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import java.time.{LocalDate, LocalDateTime}
    13→import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
    14→import scala.collection.mutable
    15→import scala.util.{Try, Success, Failure}
    16→
    17→// ============================================================================
    18→// Traits (structural typing - replaces Python Protocols)
    19→// ============================================================================
    20→
    21→trait Tokenizable {
    22→  def toToken: String
    23→}
    24→
    25→trait HasLength {
    26→  def length: Int
    27→}
    28→
    29→trait TokenProcessor[-A] {
    30→  def process(item: A): Unit
    31→}
    32→
    33→// ============================================================================
    34→// Enums and Constants
    35→// ============================================================================
    36→
    37→sealed trait TokenType {
    38→  def value: String
    39→}
    40→
    41→object TokenType {
    42→  case object StringType extends TokenType { val value = "string" }
    43→  case object Numeric extends TokenType { val value = "numeric" }
    44→  case object Temporal extends TokenType { val value = "temporal" }
    45→  case object Structured extends TokenType { val value = "structured" }
    46→  case object Binary extends TokenType { val value = "binary" }
    47→  case object Null extends TokenType { val value = "null" }
    48→}
    49→
    50→// ============================================================================
    51→// Core Token Classes
    52→// ============================================================================
    53→
    54→case class Token(
    55→    value: String,
    56→    tokenType: TokenType,
    57→    metadata: Map[String, Any] = Map.empty
    58→) {
    59→  def withMetadata(entries: (String, Any)*): Token =
    60→    copy(metadata = metadata ++ entries.toMap)
    61→}
    62→
    63→class MutableTokenBatch {
    64→  private val _tokens: mutable.ListBuffer[Token] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
    65→  private var _processed: Boolean = false
    66→
    67→  def tokens: List[Token] = _tokens.toList
    68→
    69→  def add(token: Token): Unit = {
    70→    if (_processed) throw new IllegalStateException("Batch already processed")
    71→    _tokens += token
    72→  }
    73→
    74→  def markProcessed(): Unit = {
    75→    _processed = true
    76→  }
    77→}
    78→
    79→// ============================================================================
    80→// Generic Container Classes
    81→// ============================================================================
    82→
    83→class TokenContainer[+A](items: Seq[A]) {
    84→  private val _items: Vector[A] = items.toVector
    85→
    86→  def getAll: Vector[A] = _items
    87→
    88→  def mapTokens(func: A => String): List[String] =
    89→    _items.map(func).toList
    90→}
    91→
    92→class TokenSink[-A] {
    93→  private val _received: mutable.ListBuffer[Any] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
    94→
    95→  def receive(item: A): Unit = {
    96→    _received += item
    97→  }
    98→
    99→  def drain(): List[Any] = {
   100→    val result = _received.toList
   101→    _received.clear()
   102→    result
   103→  }
   104→}
   105→
   106→class BivariantHandler[A](private var _value: A) {
   107→  def get: A = _value
   108→
   109→  def set(value: A): Unit = {
   110→    _value = value
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  def transform(func: A => A): A = {
   114→    _value = func(_value)
   115→    _value
   116→  }
   117→}
   118→
   119→// ============================================================================
   120→// Tokenizer Implementations
   121→// ============================================================================
   122→
   123→abstract class BaseTokenizer[T] {
   124→  def tokenize(value: T): Token
   125→
   126→  def tokenizeBatch(values: Iterable[T]): Iterator[Token] =
   127→    values.iterator.map(tokenize)
   128→}
   129→
   130→sealed trait StrOrBytes
   131→case class Str(value: String) extends StrOrBytes
   132→case class Bytes(value: Array[Byte]) extends StrOrBytes
   133→
   134→class StringTokenizer(
   135→    encoding: String = "UTF-8",
   136→    normalizer: String => String = identity
   137→) extends BaseTokenizer[StrOrBytes] {
   138→
   139→  override def tokenize(value: StrOrBytes): Token = {
   140→    val strValue = value match {
   141→      case Bytes(b) => new String(b, encoding)
   142→      case Str(s)   => s
   143→    }
   144→    val normalized = normalizer(strValue)
   145→    Token(normalized, TokenType.StringType)
   146→  }
   147→}
   148→
   149→sealed trait NumericValue
   150→case class IntValue(value: Int) extends NumericValue
   151→case class FloatValue(value: Double) extends NumericValue
   152→case class DecimalValue(value: BigDecimal) extends NumericValue
   153→
   154→class NumericTokenizer(
   155→    precision: Int = 6,
   156→    formatOptions: Map[String, Any] = Map.empty
   157→) extends BaseTokenizer[NumericValue] {
   158→
   159→  override def tokenize(value: NumericValue): Token = {
   160→    val (strValue, originalType) = value match {
   161→      case DecimalValue(d) => (s"%.${precision}f".format(d), "BigDecimal")
   162→      case FloatValue(f)   => (s"%.${precision}f".format(f), "Double")
   163→      case IntValue(i)     => (i.toString, "Int")
   164→    }
   165→    Token(strValue, TokenType.Numeric, Map("original_type" -> originalType))
   166→  }
   167→}
   168→
   169→sealed trait TemporalValue
   170→case class DateTimeValue(value: LocalDateTime) extends TemporalValue
   171→case class DateValue(value: LocalDate) extends TemporalValue
   172→
   173→class TemporalTokenizer(
   174→    formatStr: Option[String] = None
   175→) extends BaseTokenizer[TemporalValue] {
   176→
   177→  private val IsoFormat: DateTimeFormatter =
   178→    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss")
   179→  private val DateFormat: DateTimeFormatter =
   180→    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd")
   181→
   182→  override def tokenize(value: TemporalValue): Token = {
   183→    val formatted = formatStr match {
   184→      case Some(fmt) =>
   185→        val formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(fmt)
   186→        value match {
   187→          case DateTimeValue(dt) => dt.format(formatter)
   188→          case DateValue(d)      => d.format(formatter)
   189→        }
   190→      case None =>
   191→        value match {
   192→          case DateTimeValue(dt) => dt.format(IsoFormat)
   193→          case DateValue(d)      => d.format(DateFormat)
   194→        }
   195→    }
   196→    Token(formatted, TokenType.Temporal)
   197→  }
   198→}
   199→
   200→// ============================================================================
   201→// Advanced: Union Types via Overloading
   202→// ============================================================================
   203→
   204→class UniversalTokenizer {
   205→  private val stringTokenizer = new StringTokenizer()
   206→  private val numericTokenizer = new NumericTokenizer()
   207→  private val temporalTokenizer = new TemporalTokenizer()
   208→
   209→  def tokenize(value: String): Token =
   210→    stringTokenizer.tokenize(Str(value))
   211→
   212→  def tokenize(value: Array[Byte]): Token =
   213→    stringTokenizer.tokenize(Bytes(value))
   214→
   215→  def tokenize(value: Int): Token =
   216→    numericTokenizer.tokenize(IntValue(value))
   217→
   218→  def tokenize(value: Double): Token =
   219→    numericTokenizer.tokenize(FloatValue(value))
   220→
   221→  def tokenize(value: BigDecimal): Token =
   222→    numericTokenizer.tokenize(DecimalValue(value))
   223→
   224→  def tokenize(value: LocalDateTime): Token =
   225→    temporalTokenizer.tokenize(DateTimeValue(value))
   226→
   227→  def tokenize(value: LocalDate): Token =
   228→    temporalTokenizer.tokenize(DateValue(value))
   229→
   230→  def tokenize(value: Tokenizable): Token =
   231→    Token(value.toToken, TokenType.Structured)
   232→
   233→  def tokenizeAny(value: Any): Token = value match {
   234→    case null                => Token("NULL", TokenType.Null)
   235→    case t: Tokenizable      => Token(t.toToken, TokenType.Structured)
   236→    case s: String            => tokenize(s)
   237→    case b: Array[Byte]       => tokenize(b)
   238→    case i: Int               => tokenize(i)
   239→    case f: Double            => tokenize(f)
   240→    case d: BigDecimal        => tokenize(d)
   241→    case dt: LocalDateTime    => tokenize(dt)
   242→    case d: LocalDate         => tokenize(d)
   243→    case other                => Token(other.toString, TokenType.StringType, Map("fallback" -> true))
   244→  }
   245→}
   246→
   247→// ============================================================================
   248→// Complex Nested Generics
   249→// ============================================================================
   250→
   251→class TokenRegistry[T] {
   252→  private val _registry: mutable.Map[String, TokenContainer[T]] = mutable.Map.empty
   253→  private val _handlers: mutable.ListBuffer[T => Option[Token]] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
   254→
   255→  def register(key: String, container: TokenContainer[T]): Unit = {
   256→    _registry(key) = container
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  def addHandler(handler: T => Option[Token]): Unit = {
   260→    _handlers += handler
   261→  }
   262→
   263→  def process(key: String): List[Option[Token]] = {
   264→    _registry.get(key) match {
   265→      case None => List.empty
   266→      case Some(container) =>
   267→        container.getAll.map { item =>
   268→          _handlers.iterator
   269→            .map(handler => handler(item))
   270→            .collectFirst { case Some(token) => token }
   271→        }.toList
   272→    }
   273→  }
   274→}
   275→
   276→// ============================================================================
   277→// Higher-Kinded Type Simulation → Proper Functor/Monad
   278→// ============================================================================
   279→
   280→class TokenFunctor[A](protected val _value: A) {
   281→  def map[B](func: A => B): TokenFunctor[B] =
   282→    new TokenFunctor(func(_value))
   283→
   284→  def flatMap[B](func: A => TokenFunctor[B]): TokenFunctor[B] =
   285→    func(_value)
   286→
   287→  def getOrElse(default: => A): A =
   288→    if (_value != null) _value else default
   289→}
   290→
   291→class TokenMonad[A](value: A) extends TokenFunctor[A](value) {
   292→  def ap[B](funcWrapped: TokenMonad[A => B]): TokenMonad[B] =
   293→    new TokenMonad(funcWrapped._value(this._value))
   294→}
   295→
   296→object TokenMonad {
   297→  def pure[A](value: A): TokenMonad[A] = new TokenMonad(value)
   298→}
   299→
   300→// ============================================================================
   301→// JSON Structure Tokenization
   302→// ============================================================================
   303→
   304→sealed trait JsonValue
   305→case class JsonString(value: String) extends JsonValue
   306→case class JsonInt(value: Int) extends JsonValue
   307→case class JsonDouble(value: Double) extends JsonValue
   308→case class JsonBoolean(value: Boolean) extends JsonValue
   309→case object JsonNull extends JsonValue
   310→case class JsonArray(items: List[JsonValue]) extends JsonValue
   311→case class JsonObject(fields: Map[String, JsonValue]) extends JsonValue
   312→
   313→class JsonTokenizer(pretty: Boolean = false) {
   314→
   315→  private def toJsonString(value: JsonValue): String = {
   316→    value match {
   317→      case JsonString(s)  => "\"" + escapeJson(s) + "\""
   318→      case JsonInt(i)     => i.toString
   319→      case JsonDouble(d)  => d.toString
   320→      case JsonBoolean(b) => b.toString
   321→      case JsonNull       => "null"
   322→      case JsonArray(items) =>
   323→        val elements = items.map(toJsonString)
   324→        if (pretty) formatPrettyArray(elements)
   325→        else "[" + elements.mkString(", ") + "]"
   326→      case JsonObject(fields) =>
   327→        val entries = fields.map { case (k, v) =>
   328→          "\"" + escapeJson(k) + "\": " + toJsonString(v)
   329→        }
   330→        if (pretty) formatPrettyObject(entries)
   331→        else "{" + entries.mkString(", ") + "}"
   332→    }
   333→  }
   334→
   335→  private def escapeJson(s: String): String =
   336→    s.replace("\\", "\\\\")
   337→      .replace("\"", "\\\"")
   338→      .replace("\n", "\\n")
   339→      .replace("\r", "\\r")
   340→      .replace("\t", "\\t")
   341→
   342→  private def formatPrettyArray(elements: List[String]): String = {
   343→    if (elements.isEmpty) "[]"
   344→    else {
   345→      val indented = elements.map(e => indent(e, 2)).mkString(",\n")
   346→      "[\n" + indented + "\n]"
   347→    }
   348→  }
   349→
   350→  private def formatPrettyObject(entries: Iterable[String]): String = {
   351→    if (entries.isEmpty) "{}"
   352→    else {
   353→      val indented = entries.map(e => indent(e, 2)).mkString(",\n")
   354→      "{\n" + indented + "\n}"
   355→    }
   356→  }
   357→
   358→  private def indent(s: String, spaces: Int): String =
   359→    s.linesIterator.map(" " * spaces + _).mkString("\n")
   360→
   361→  def tokenize(value: JsonValue): Token =
   362→    Token(toJsonString(value), TokenType.Structured, Map("json" -> true))
   363→
   364→  def tokenizePath(value: JsonValue, path: String): Option[Token] = {
   365→    val parts = path.split("\\.")
   366→    navigatePath(value, parts.toList).map(tokenize)
   367→  }
   368→
   369→  private def navigatePath(current: JsonValue, parts: List[String]): Option[JsonValue] = {
   370→    parts match {
   371→      case Nil => Some(current)
   372→      case head :: tail =>
   373→        current match {
   374→          case JsonObject(fields) =>
   375→            fields.get(head).flatMap(navigatePath(_, tail))
   376→          case JsonArray(items) =>
   377→            Try(head.toInt).toOption
   378→              .filter(idx => idx >= 0 && idx < items.length)
   379→              .flatMap(idx => navigatePath(items(idx), tail))
   380→          case _ => None
   381→        }
   382→    }
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// ============================================================================
   387→// Whitespace Tokenizer - Basic Text Tokenization
   388→// ============================================================================
   389→
   390→class WhitespaceTokenizer(
   391→    lowercase: Boolean = false,
   392→    minLength: Int = 0,
   393→    maxLength: Option[Int] = None,
   394→    stripPunctuation: Boolean = false
   395→) {
   396→  private val punctuation: Set[Char] =
   397→    ".,!?;:'\"()[]{}".toSet
   398→
   399→  private def processToken(word: String): Option[String] = {
   400→    var processed = word
   401→
   402→    if (stripPunctuation) {
   403→      processed = processed.dropWhile(punctuation.contains).reverse.dropWhile(punctuation.contains).reverse
   404→    }
   405→
   406→    if (lowercase) {
   407→      processed = processed.toLowerCase
   408→    }
   409→
   410→    if (processed.length < minLength) return None
   411→
   412→    maxLength.foreach { max =>
   413→      if (processed.length > max) {
   414→        processed = processed.take(max)
   415→      }
   416→    }
   417→
   418→    if (processed.isEmpty) None else Some(processed)
   419→  }
   420→
   421→  def tokenize(text: String): List[Token] = {
   422→    val words = text.split("\\s+").filter(_.nonEmpty)
   423→    words.zipWithIndex.flatMap { case (word, i) =>
   424→      processToken(word).map { processed =>
   425→        Token(
   426→          value = processed,
   427→          tokenType = TokenType.StringType,
   428→          metadata = Map("position" -> i, "original" -> word)
   429→        )
   430→      }
   431→    }.toList
   432→  }
   433→
   434→  def tokenizeToStrings(text: String): List[String] =
   435→    tokenize(text).map(_.value)
   436→
   437→  def tokenizeWithPositions(text: String): List[(String, Int, Int)] = {
   438→    val result = mutable.ListBuffer.empty[(String, Int, Int)]
   439→    var currentPos = 0
   440→
   441→    for (word <- text.split("\\s+").filter(_.nonEmpty)) {
   442→      val start = text.indexOf(word, currentPos)
   443→      val end = start + word.length
   444→
   445→      processToken(word).foreach { processed =>
   446→        result += ((processed, start, end))
   447→      }
   448→
   449→      currentPos = end
   450→    }
   451→
   452→    result.toList
   453→  }
   454→
   455→  def countTokens(text: String): Int =
   456→    tokenize(text).length
   457→}
   458→
   459→// ============================================================================
   460→// Builder Pattern with Fluent Interface
   461→// ============================================================================
   462→
   463→class TokenizerBuilder[T] {
   464→  private val _normalizers: mutable.ListBuffer[String => String] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
   465→  private val _validators: mutable.ListBuffer[T => Boolean] = mutable.ListBuffer.empty
   466→  private var _metadata: Map[String, Any] = Map.empty
   467→
   468→  def withNormalizer(normalizer: String => String): TokenizerBuilder[T] = {
   469→    _normalizers += normalizer
   470→    this
   471→  }
   472→
   473→  def withValidator(validator: T => Boolean): TokenizerBuilder[T] = {
   474→    _validators += validator
   475→    this
   476→  }
   477→
   478→  def withMetadata(entries: (String, Any)*): TokenizerBuilder[T] = {
   479→    _metadata = _metadata ++ entries.toMap
   480→    this
   481→  }
   482→
   483→  def build(): T => Token = {
   484→    val normalizers = _normalizers.toList
   485→    val validators = _validators.toList
   486→    val metadata = _metadata
   487→
   488→    (value: T) => {
   489→      validators.foreach { validator =>
   490→        if (!validator(value))
   491→          throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"Validation failed for $value")
   492→      }
   493→
   494→      var strValue = value.toString
   495→      normalizers.foreach { normalizer =>
   496→        strValue = normalizer(strValue)
   497→      }
   498→
   499→      Token(strValue, TokenType.StringType, metadata)
   500→    }
   501→  }
   502→}
   503→
